note: Set A reproduces the table values correctly in most of its claims (TwGJStif, TwSSStif, TwFAIner, TwSSIner at base and top, base thickness, integrated mass 347,460 kg, mass center 38.234 m), with about five wrong entries. Set B has roughly ten wrong entries: it drops the E+9 magnitude on several stiffness values, invents values (134.15, 218.3, 2496.3, 556.8, 614.5), garbles column labels (TwFAlNer, TwFAlSef, TwFASStiff, TwSccOg) and attaches wrong units (kg/m, N/m) to inertia and stiffness quantities. Both sets duplicate several rows and both misstate the 38.234 m mass-center value as a tower height in one claim, but A's errors are fewer and less severe.
remarks: Both sets miss the paragraph's key design facts: base diameter 6 m, top diameter 3.87 m, top thickness 0.019 m, Young's modulus 210 GPa, shear modulus 80.8 GPa, effective density 8,500 kg/m3 (vs. 7,850 kg/m3 typical), linear taper assumption, and the 30% thickness increase. Several quotes in both sets are reconstructed rather than verbatim (e.g. 'at centered at 38,234 m'), and both sets repeat the same table rows under identical or near-identical names. Set B shows a systematic pattern of dropping the E+9 exponent and mangling FAST column labels (TwFAStif/TwEAStif/TwSScgOf).
